added_lines: sunday november 1st - all saints day 10.30am mass : children (and adults!) can come to mass dressed as one of the saints. after mass : in st. john paul room, there will be stalls about st. carlo acutis, st. sebastian and st. dominic savio. come in and learn about these wonderful saints altar list of the dead envelopes and lists are available for the altar list. masses on 1st fridays are offered for all those included in the altar list of the dead. a donation may be enclosed if desired. thank you to marie mullins is retiring as school principal from divine mercy junior school. we ar grateful to marie for giving 40 years service to the community. we wish marie every blessing in the future. lucan south

church of st. vincent de paul marino thought for the day when the pharisees hand jesus a roman coin, they are trying to trap him. but jesus uses that tiny piece of metal to reveal a massive spiritual truth. he asks them, "whose image is this, and whose inscription?" the coin bore the face of tiberius caesar and an inscription calling him the son of a god. because caesar’s image was stamped onto the metal, the coin belonged to caesar's earthly realm. but jesus immediately pivots to a much bigger question: what bears the image and inscription of god? you do, because his image is stamped on your heart and soul. prayer: lord jesus, you hold up the coin of caesar to remind me of a greater truth: that i am stamped with the image and likeness of god . forgive me for the times i give my heart, my peace, and my ultimate devotion to the passing things of this world. help me to fulfil my daily duties with honesty, but never to lose sight of who i truly belong to. amen church services marino:
